notes: Build from the items you have: each character's page has a My items list (type a name and press Enter; "x2" for a second copy of a ring). "Build from my items" makes the best build out of only those, and lists what's worth getting next: the items you don't have that would help that build most. You can also just tell the bot "I have these items, make a build", or use the new box in the form. A ring you have one of is never worn twice. Fixed: skill points are now worked out in the game's own equip order (boots first, like Wynnbuilder). Before, a few builds with negative skill point items could need a couple more points than shown (a friend's level 50 build needed 99, not 97). Ability points that wouldn't help your goal are now left unspent, with ideas for where to put them.
